workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(server): validate message parts before creating the session. Target files: openviking/server/routers/sessions.py, tests/server/test_session_message_validation.py. Both message endpoints auto-create the session **before** validating the message parts: (Ref: https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7640)

workarounds.symptom: Managed hooks reject supported description and statusMessage metadata during extension installation
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(serve): accept hook description and statusMessage during extension preparation. Target files: packages/cli/src/serve/managed-extension-manifests.test.ts, packages/cli/src/serve/managed-hook-runtime.test.ts, packages/cli/src/serve/managed-hook-runtime.ts. Managed extension preparation now accepts the standard hook display strings `description` and `statusMessage` on command, HTTP, prompt, and function hooks. A missing value is still allowed, a non-string value is still rejected, and any other unknown field stays closed. (Ref: https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17439)

workarounds.symptom: Miniflare email() handler message has no canBeForwarded property in local dev
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [miniflare] Expose canBeForwarded boolean property on ForwardableEmailMessage in email handler. Target files: packages/miniflare/src/workers/core/email.ts, packages/miniflare/test/index.spec.ts, .changeset/miniflare-email-can-be-forwarded.md. In `wrangler dev`, the `ForwardableEmailMessage` passed to a Worker's `email()` handler previously had no `canBeForwarded` property (reading as `undefined` and `"canBeForwarded" in message` as `false`), whereas production `workerd` exposes it as a read-only boolean. workarounds.symptom: A rejected pack import leaves the materialized upload behind
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(server): validate pack import parent before materializing the upload. Target files: openviking/server/routers/pack.py, tests/server/test_pack_import_cleanup.py. `POST /api/v1/pack/import` consumed the uploaded pack **before** validating the target parent URI: (Ref: https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7612)

workarounds.symptom: Agents: promptCacheRetention is dropped for GPT-6 models and logs a warning on every call
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(core): Do not send promptCacheRetention to GPT-6 and later models. Target files: packages/@n8n/agents/src/runtime/model/prompt-cache.ts, packages/@n8n/agents/src/types/sdk/agent.ts, packages/@n8n/agents/src/runtime/model/__tests__/prompt-cache.test.ts. Stop sending `promptCacheRetention` to GPT-6 and later models unless it is set explicitly, and assume the in-memory default for them when working out how long the provider keeps the cache warm. Other OpenAI models keep the 24 hour default, including gpt-5.6. (Ref: https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/pull/44000)

workarounds.symptom: OMP provider: omp 18.x workers read as completed while still running (handoff tears them down)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(omp): detect OMP 18 working, ready and completion states. Target files: src/cli_agent_orchestrator/providers/omp.py, test/providers/test_omp_unit.py, docs/omp-cli.md. The OMP provider was calibrated on OMP 17.2.10. On omp 18.x a dispatched worker reads as completed while it is still running, and a handoff tears it down seconds after dispatch. With the default `composer.shape: band`, it never reaches a ready state at all. Details and a 17.x vs 18.x comparison are in #1344. (Ref: https://github.com/awslabs/cli-agent-orchestrator/pull/1345)
